title: Agent protocol
description: The messages agents and the office exchange over the agent connection.
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @outstaff/protocol run docs:protocol`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Protocol version: **4**. Agents open the connection to the office; the office never connects to an agent. The messages are defined once, as schemas in the `@outstaff/protocol` package, which both sides use.

## Framing

Messages are JSON text frames over a WebSocket. Every message has this shape:

```json
{ "id": "m1", "replyTo": "m0", "type": "heartbeat", "payload": {} }
```

- `id` is unique per sender. `replyTo` is set on a response and holds the `id` of the request.
- A request gets exactly one response: the result message listed for it, `ack`, or `error`.
- The first message from the agent must be `hello`. Anything else gets an `unauthenticated` error and the connection closes.
- A message that is not valid JSON, has an unknown `type`, or has a payload that does not match gets an `error` back. The connection stays open.
- Frames are limited to 1 MiB.

## Connection life cycle

1. The agent connects and sends `hello` with its handle, token and protocol version.
2. The office answers `welcome`, or `error` and closes the connection (`auth_failed`, `version_mismatch`). The close codes are 4401 and 4426.
3. The office offers the next work item, or offers again the items that were not accepted before. The agent sends `accept` (or `decline`).
4. While working the agent sends `heartbeat` at least every `heartbeatMs`, `progress` and `journal` as it goes, and finally `handback` or `fail`. The office then offers the next item. The office answers `heartbeat` and `ping` as they arrive, ahead of the agent's earlier requests it is still handling; the agent reconnects only after two heartbeats in a row go unanswered.
5. A person has one connection. A new connection with valid credentials replaces the old one, which closes with code 4409.
6. After a disconnect the agent reconnects with backoff and sends `hello` again, naming the items it is still running in `hello.running`. The office reconciles: an item it has active that the agent is not running (an offer that was never accepted, or a run the agent lost) goes back to the queue and is offered again, and `welcome.resume` lists the running items it kept. A run only starts when the office receives `accept`. The agent sends `handback`, `fail` and `act_result` that failed with the connection once more on the new one.
7. At any time, also during a run, the office may send `act`: tracker and knowledge-base changes the event pipeline decided for the person. The agent's process makes them with the person's own credentials, without a model run, and answers `act_result`. An act it has not answered comes again in the next `welcome.acts`, so an offline agent makes it when it connects.

Delivery is at least once and idempotent by work item id: an offer may arrive twice, and `accept`, `handback` and the other item messages may be repeated safely.

## Error codes

`malformed`, `unknown_type`, `invalid_message`, `unauthenticated`, `auth_failed`, `version_mismatch`, `replaced`, `unknown_item`, `not_found`, `invalid`, `unsupported`, `failed`.

## Messages

### `hello`

First message on every connection. Authenticates the person, checks the protocol version and names the items the agent is still running, so the office can reconcile its view with the agent's.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `welcome`, `error`.

| Field             | Type           | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------- | -------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `person`          | string         | yes      | Handle of the person this agent runs as.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `token`           | string         | yes      | The person's agent token.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `protocolVersion` | integer        | yes      | PROTOCOL_VERSION the agent speaks.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `agentVersion`    | string         | yes      | Version of the agent software.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `running`         | list of string | yes      | Ids of the accepted items this agent is still running, empty after a start. The office requeues every other item it has active for the person: an offer the agent never took, or a run it no longer has. |

### `welcome`

The connection is accepted. Carries the team config the agent works from, and lists the running items the office kept, the reports to requesters the agent was offline for and the acts it has not answered; the agent posts and makes those itself and confirms each.

Sent by: office.

| Field                                | Type                  | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `protocolVersion`                    | integer               | yes      | PROTOCOL_VERSION the office speaks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `heartbeatMs`                        | integer               | yes      | Send a heartbeat at least this often.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `team`                               | object                | yes      | The team config the office loaded, validated and with its defaults filled in. The agent validates it again, renders its working files from it and, when a later welcome brings a different one, renders them again between work items. It holds no secrets: the team file names the secrets adapters need, and each agent reads its own from its secret source. |
| `resume`                             | list of string        | yes      | Ids of the items named in `hello.running` that the office still has active: the agent carries on with these. A running item missing here was ended by the office while the agent was away.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `reports`                            | list of objects       | no       | Reports to a requester that the agent did not post when its item ended, because it was offline. The agent posts each one now, as itself; the office does not send them again.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `reports[].id`                       | string                | yes      | Id of this report. The office sends it again until the agent confirms with `report_posted`, so the agent skips an id it posted already.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `reports[].workItemId`               | string                | yes      | Id of the work item.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `reports[].kind`                     | `result` or `blocked` | yes      | How the item ended.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `reports[].text`                     | string                | yes      | What the agent handed back: the summary to report.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `reports[].requester`                | string                | no       | Id of the requester to mention.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `reports[].links`                    | list of objects       | yes      | The ticket and pull requests of the item.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `reports[].links[].url`              | string                | yes      | Absolute URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `reports[].links[].title`            | string                | no       | Label for the link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `reports[].threads`                  | list of objects       | no       | Every thread linked to the item now, to post the report in: the one it came from and the ones attached later. Absent when the report goes to a direct message instead.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `reports[].threads[].channel`        | string                | yes      | Chat channel of the request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `reports[].threads[].thread`         | string                | yes      | Thread the agent answers in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `reports[].threads[].requester`      | object                | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `reports[].threads[].requester.id`   | string                | yes      | Id of the requester in the chat workspace.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `reports[].threads[].requester.name` | string                | no       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `reports[].threads[].direct`         | boolean               | yes      | The conversation is a direct message with the requester.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `reports[].threads[].participant`    | boolean               | yes      | The requester started the thread or replied in it, so the chat already notifies them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `reports[].direct`                   | string                | no       | For a blocked report on an item without a chat thread: the requester's chat user id. Open a direct message with them and post the report there.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `acts`                               | list of objects       | no       | Acts the agent has not answered yet, for example because it was offline when the office decided them. The agent makes each one's changes now, as itself, and answers with `act_result`.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `acts[].id`                          | string                | yes      | Id of the act. The office sends it again until the agent answers with `act_result`, so the agent makes an id's changes once and only answers again.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `acts[].ops`                         | list of any           | yes      | The changes, made in order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### `offer`

A work item for the agent to take, with its context. Delivered at least once: an offer that was not accepted is sent again after a reconnect, so handle the same id twice.

Sent by: office.

| Field                                         | Type                                                                                                                  | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `workItem`                                    | object                                                                                                                | yes      | The item to work on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `workItem.id`                                 | string                                                                                                                | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `workItem.kind`                               | string                                                                                                                | yes      | What the work is, for example a ticket, a review round or a question.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `workItem.title`                              | string                                                                                                                | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `workItem.priority`                           | number                                                                                                                | yes      | Lower runs first.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `workItem.trigger`                            | `human` or `agent` or `automation` or `schedule`                                                                      | yes      | Who started the item: for a mention (`asked`), who mentioned. A question, an unblock and an agent's mention are started by another agent: their round starts no new work.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `workItem.parentId`                           | string                                                                                                                | no       | The item this one was split from, for questions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

### `accept`

Takes an offered item. Accepting twice is harmless.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                                                            |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item.                                                   |
| `runtime`    | string | yes      | The runtime adapter this agent runs the item on, for example `claude`. |
| `model`      | string | yes      | The model the person is configured with (`people[].model`).            |

### `decline`

Gives an offered item back to the queue.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item.              |
| `reason`     | string | yes      | Why the agent cannot take it now. |

### `heartbeat`

Shows the agent is alive and, optionally, still working on an item.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | no       | The item being worked on, if any. |

### `progress`

A short status line about the item, shown to people.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item. |
| `text`       | string | yes      |                      |

### `session`

Stores the runtime session of an item, so a later round of the item resumes it. One session per item; sessions are never shared between items.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item.                                                                                                      |
| `sessionId`  | string | yes      | Id of the runtime session working the item.                                                                               |
| `model`      | string | no       | The concrete model id the runtime reports it started with, when it reports one (for example the full id behind an alias). |

### `usage`

Reports the LLM usage windows the runtime sees. The office keeps the latest report per person (and for people who share a subscription) and uses it for the usage policy.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field                   | Type            | Required | Description                                                           |
| ----------------------- | --------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `windows`               | list of objects | yes      | The runtime's current LLM usage windows; replaces the earlier report. |
| `windows[].name`        | string          | yes      | Which limit, for example five_hour or seven_day.                      |
| `windows[].utilization` | number          | yes      | Fraction of the limit used; 1 is the limit.                           |
| `windows[].resetsAt`    | string          | no       | ISO-8601 time at which the window resets.                             |

### `journal`

Appends a line to the item's journal, which later rounds start from.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field        | Type   | Required | Description          |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | -------------------- |
| `workItemId` | string | yes      | Id of the work item. |
| `text`       | string | yes      |                      |

### `handback`

Finishes a round of the item with a summary, and the tokens and cost the round used, which the office records on the run and adds to the totals of the item's tickets.

Sent by: agent. Answered by: `ack`, `error`.

| Field             | Type                                                          | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `workItemId`      | string                                                        | yes      | Id of the work item.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `summary`         | string                                                        | yes      | What was done, decisions and open points.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `message`         | string                                                        | no       | The agent's short message for the human the hand-back goes to: what changed since they last looked and what it needs from them. A notice to the human leads with it; without it, with the summary.                                                                                                                                          |
| `links`           | list of objects                                               | yes      | Pull requests, documents and tickets touched.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `links[].url`     | string                                                        | yes      | Absolute URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `links[].title`   | string                                                        | no       | Label for the link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `status`          | `done` or `waiting` or `blocked` or `silent` or `interrupted` | yes      | Whether the item is finished with a result to review, waits for something, is stuck, finished silently (nothing to hand on: the item is done and its ticket is put back as the round found it), or was cut short by the agent shutting down. An interrupted item goes back to the front of the queue and is offered again with its session. |

### `act`

Tracker or knowledge-base changes the event pipeline decided for the agent (an `act` decision): moves, assignments, comments, parents, pull request and document links, and the ticket's usage fields (`set_field`, which the office decides itself after a round, not the pipeline). Sent while the agent is connected; the `welcome` carries the ones it has not answered.

### `ack`

The request succeeded and has nothing to return.

Sent by: office.

No payload fields.

### `error`

A request failed, or a message was malformed or not understood. Never closes the connection by itself, except for authentication and version errors.

Sent by: either side.

| Field     | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Required | Description |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `code`    | `malformed` or `unknown_type` or `invalid_message` or `unauthenticated` or `auth_failed` or `version_mismatch` or `replaced` or `unknown_item` or `not_found` or `invalid` or `unsupported` or `failed` | yes      |             |
| `message` | string                                                                                                                                                                                                  | yes      |             |

### `ping`

Liveness check.

Sent by: either side. Answered by: `pong`.

No payload fields.

### `pong`

Answers a ping.

Sent by: either side.

No payload fields.
